verdict.rationale: Navan documents breaking down spend by department, vendor, or category through its MCP/AI query surface (navan-docs-21, navan-docs-5). Its Ava assistant is described as working on 'real-time spend data' (navan-docs-31), and the API exposes Navan and Connect card transactions (navan-docs-4). However, the real-time claim is a single marketing line, and the breakdowns are shown mainly through natural-language queries rather than a documented live spend dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that transactions appear the same day they occur, a native real-time spend dashboard by team/category/merchant, and independent or hands-on confirmation of spend-data freshness.
